verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a deterministic secret-scanning CLI with git, dir and stdin scan modes, pre-commit hooks and a GitHub Action. It is not an AI agent or LLM application that would act as an MCP client and call tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so this axis is a category error for the product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
